description: Issue #182 (3), the case that gets NO question: the issue declares `data/demo/facilities.json` under `## 対象ファイル` and cites the longer `web/public/dist/data/demo/facilities.json` under `## 根拠`, so the author has already said which of the two spellings is the target. The pair is still a shadow pair, but only one of them reaches the scope, and asking anyway would fire a blocking question at a body that did everything right — the fastest way to teach an operator to reach for --allow-questions by habit. This is also the worst outcome the old drop produced: the declared path was the SHORTER one, so it was dropped, the cited build output was the only candidate left, the context heading demoted THAT to a reference, and the issue planned with an EMPTY scope (`no_suspected_files`) plus a `shadowed_file_candidate` warning. Now it plans clean: the declared file is the scope, the build output is a reference.
